scope:
Run original ARM Pet::addKillEnemyNum on an in-memory factory pet.

Inputs use synthetic state; native setters, getters and target execute without
substitution. This is not a battle, save, UI or Player-level integration oracle.

provenance.engine: Unicorn ARM; recover-new-game.py and recover-pet-rules.py adapters
provenance.state: Native type and kill count setters/getters; synthetic in-memory encrypted loyalty at pet+0x34c.
provenance.limitations: Single synthetic factory pet; types 0/3 are synthetic probes, not asserted gameplay roles. No negative inputs, signed overflow, battle, Player::addPetKillNum, persistence, contribution refresh, UI or network. Target, type and kill count getters/setters and encryption methods execute unhooked; existing platform and Cocos adapters apply.
